notes: This typed notice is dated 14 octobre 1983 and announces the thesis defense of MONTI Dominique in ECOLOGIE GENERALE ET APPLIQUEE OPTION ECOLOGIE AQUATIQUE. The title concerns sampling-plan optimization for mapping benthic communities and an application to the macrofauna of the étang de Pierre Blanche. The notice gives the proposed defense date and place, M. AMANIEU as thesis director, the laboratory, four abstract paragraphs, a duration of 3 ans, and a five-name jury. The abstract asks about sampling effort and precision, then describes different sub-samplings and comparisons of resulting maps with a reference map. These are reported as the wording of the notice; no mathematical verification or additional result is supplied. The literal Date,-heure, unaccented capital headings, baseline 3e, abbreviations, punctuation, and unmatched opening title quotation remain as printed. The signature is drawn without resolving its proposed name. The whole scan and both prepared halves were read once, and all nine crops were viewed. The blind audit confirms the keyed rows of 13 circumflex marks and 56 equals signs, the two dates, reference number, baseline 3e and marginal 5.
